title: NCAA: EAC pulls away from Lyceum for second win
summary: Emilio Aguinaldo College claimed its second win in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament on Friday after pulling away from Lyceum, 89-79, at the Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
